notes: Synthetic volume uses the disposable PostgreSQL database on port 55439.
Live readers ran in pinned read-only transactions; browser profiling blocked all non-GET/HEAD requests.
Timing samples are sequential observations, not statistical percentiles or an SLA.
Live database measurements exclude migration 009; its indexes were applied only to the disposable test database.
Browser documentBytes is decoded HTML plus React payload. transferBytes includes compressed document transfer and headers; it excludes JS, fonts, and other requests.
